Description: Caster is able to communicate basic ideas in a specific language (hungry, thirsty, bathroom, peace, etc.). For the duration of this spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 2 in the language
Target must answer one single concept question

As Speech I, except caster can communicate in more complex concepts, although there is a good chance of misinterpretation. For the duration of this spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 4 in the language
Caster can broadcast his thoughts to minds within the area of affect
Target will follow a single suggested act that is not completely alien to him (e.g., no suicide suggestions, no blinding himself suggestions, etc.)

As Speech I, except caster is reasonably fluent in the language. Caster's accent is imperfect, but there is only a slight chance of misinterpretation. For the duration of this spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 6 in the language
Target is forced to obey caster as in Suggestion, for as long as caster concentrates and speaks to the target. Caster can concentrate on this spell and a Speech spell at the same time
As Minor Mind Speech, except range is 100'
As Minor Mind Speech, except range is 300'
Target is forced into complete inaction for that round (the caster must command the target to stop)

As Speech, except caster is absolutely fluent, has an accent as a native, and has complete idiomatic knowledge of language. For the duration of this spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 4 in the language
Everyone within the area of effect, is stunned for 1 round per 10 failure (the caster is immune)
As Mind Speech, except caster can limit broadcast to desired beings
Target is forced to obey caster in all things, including suicide and similar actions. WAY OF THE VOICE
